lines.text: Many learners say: She has a good style.
Better: She has a good figure.
Say figure for a body shape.
Figure! She has a good figure.

data.why: Say figure for a body shape.

quiz.stem: Her body shape is great. She has a good ___.

native.tip: 体型がいいは good figure。英語の style は服装や着こなしのセンスを指します。
native.caption: “She has a good style.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語の「スタイルがいい」をそのまま言うと、意味がずれてしまいます。“She has a good figure.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“figure”。“She has a good figure.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: For a nice body shape, say good figure. Style means how you dress.
en.caption: Do you say this? “She has a good style.” 😅 In Japanese, “style” can mean body shape, but in English it does not. The natural way is “She has a good figure.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
